briefing.title: Contract
briefing.default_body: Short night contract. Hit the objective and stay out of vision cones.
briefing.tut_01_body: Pick up the bat. Strike the patrol from behind. Reach the exit.
briefing.tut_02_body: Patrol walks the booth. Don't walk into the cone — flank or wait.
briefing.tut_03_body: Case in the mid room. Shotgun covers the south door — take the north flank.
briefing.plat_01_body: Three bays. North path is faster, south is safer. Shotgun in the middle.
briefing.plat_02_body: Never push the shotgun door. The side route has a sniper beam.
briefing.plat_03_body: Blackout Harbor: case under a shield. Shotgun on the south choke. S = no alarm.
briefing.plat_04_body: VIP in the office (amber mark). You can skip the rest. Exit after the hit.
briefing.plat_05_body: Silent dock. Knife and bat only. Crossing routes — keep the noise down.
briefing.plat_06_body: Cubicle maze. Backstabs pay. Shotgun waits on the last choke.
briefing.plat_07_body: Three lanes. Center is aggression, sides are stealth. Clear all, then exit.
briefing.plat_08_body: Plat finale: case behind VIP and shotgun. Clock is ticking — grab and go.
briefing.port_01_body: Zarya Gate: case in the vault. More patrols, same extract loop.
briefing.port_02_body: Warehouse aisles. Long sightlines. Case mid-row — carry it to the exit.
briefing.port_03_body: Port Storm. Pocket rooms with shotguns and a shield. Survive the clear.
